randomness_note: Task and schedule seeds do not seed provider sampling.

preparation.plan: One model request per task/repeat before artifact generation.
preparation.artifact: Model-generated by flat execution with public feedback, no reference solution.
preparation.qualification: Public and hidden all-pass; hidden grade is never model feedback.
preparation.selection: One bounded preparation attempt per assigned slot; no reroll, replacement, or outcome-based selection.
preparation.cost: Recorded separately once per pair, excluded from both identical repair budgets; report preparation plus repair totals.

treatment.fixed: Use unchanged initial hierarchy instructions with public failure feedback.
treatment.adaptive: One instruction-revision request immediately after fork, charged to the same repair budget; rejected revision consumes its request and is retained.
treatment.revision_scope: Only the failed target leaf instruction and revision count may change.
treatment.artifact_scope: Both arms may replace any existing artifact field; locality is measured, not guaranteed by field filtering.
treatment.fork: Identical post-fault artifact, environment, root, initial plan and public feedback; empty repair history in both arms.
treatment.hidden_inputs: Never expose source artifact, preparation history, hidden grading feedback, or reference solution to repair prompts.

execution_policy.time_semantics: Batch threshold is checked before each phase; phase threshold before requests and after responses. In-flight work can exceed these thresholds; actual elapsed time is retained. Workflow limit is 260 minutes.
execution_policy.unknown_usage: null total with known partial usage and counted request attempt
execution_policy.budget_semantics: Logical token usage includes all completed responses, including invalid or rejected actions; after-response overage fails the phase and is retained. Token thresholds are not a hard billing ceiling because input usage is learned after the response.

analysis.primary: Independently graded recovery conditional on a qualified common checkpoint.
analysis.pairing_unit: Task/repeat checkpoint; repeats share task content and are not independent tasks.
analysis.pilot_purpose: Apparatus, accounting, provenance, ceiling and feasibility; no confirmatory efficacy PASS.
analysis.preparation_failures: Report yield and reasons separately; never classify as a treatment failure or silently remove from the assignment flow.
analysis.missing_treatment: Retain missing/uncertain assigned slots and pair incompleteness; do not impute recovery.
analysis.optional_stopping: None for treatment outcomes; only frozen infrastructure/integrity/time limits stop execution.
analysis.scope: Replanning procedure including diagnosis and instruction revision, not isolated text rewriting or hierarchy-versus-flat effectiveness.

task_non_overlap.scope: Exact task IDs, root/spec hashes and initial environment hashes; same task families are reused.
